title: ENDURANCE A · BUILD THE ENGINE
emphasis: Baseline plan. Tell your coach what you actually completed.

deposits.title: STEADY ENDURANCE

exercises.name: Steady treadmill or outdoor walk
exercises.cue: Keep a pace that lets you speak complete sentences.
exercises.prescription: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.
exercises.home: 35 min moderate continuous walking/jogging; conversational breathing.

deposits.effort: 35 min at a conversational pace. Start with 20–25 min if this exceeds recent capacity.
deposits.label: A

deposits.title: ACTIVE MOBILITY

exercises.name: Hips, ankles and thoracic rotation
exercises.cue: Use comfortable active range. No forced stretching.
exercises.prescription: 4 min easy 90/90 switches, knee-to-wall rocks and open books; split time evenly.
exercises.home: 2 min easy hip switches and ankle rocks.
exercises.away: Use the listed unloaded regression or comparable available equipment

exercises.name: Iron Neck · easy control
exercises.home: 2 min of familiar, light controlled neck work. Substitute open books if uncomfortable or setup is a hassle.
exercises.cue: Small comfortable range; no ballistic motion or strain.

deposits.effort: Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve. Rest is included in the timer.
deposits.label: B

levels.bonus: Optional brisk walk; dummy lab separate

weekSummary: Mon strength A · Tue endurance · Wed strength B · Thu endurance · Fri strength C · Sat boxing · Sun recovery

martialSupplement.name: DUMMY LAB · SINGLE-LEG STUDY
martialSupplement.home: Repeat entry; pause at head and hand position. 3 slow repetitions/side; name the hardest checkpoint.
martialSupplement.away: Visualize the same positions and write one question.
martialSupplement.cue: One question: where do posture or connection change? Pause and inspect.
martialSupplement.text: 7 min slow technical study. Record one discovery. Not conditioning.
